theme: Peak Dal Lake demand - travellers booking every houseboat they can find; an unlisted boat loses the guest to a listed one. Karew Sa Join Kashrew
season: Peak summer (early July 2026). The Amarnath Yatra is underway (3 Jul - 28 Aug), so the valley is busy and fully open and hotels, cabs and boats are filling fast. Flights landing in Srinagar, every pass and the Z-Morh tunnel clear, Gulmarg's meadow green with the gondola running, the high meadows at Sonamarg and Pahalgam lush and cool (5-15C), and Srinagar warm by day and cool at night (roughly 15-30C) while the plains bake. Brief afternoon showers possible.
campaign_name: Houseboats Peak-week Dal demand, list your boat [INR] - 07 Jul 2026
subject: The lake is full this week and your boat is unlisted
